description: Get the full record for one Open Charge Map station by its numeric OCM ID. Returns every connection (type, level, power, current, quantity, per-connection status), the operator and network, usage and access restrictions (pay-at-location, membership, access key), the number of charge points, general comments, usage cost, the data provider, media, and verification recency. Set includeComments to also return community check-ins inline.

includeComments.description: Include community check-ins and comments inline in the response. Adds payload but gives the real-world reliability signal alongside the registry status. Every comment on record comes back at once, unpaged — on a station with hundreds of check-ins that is a large response, so prefer openchargemap_get_station_comments, which returns them a page at a time.

name: openchargemap_get_station

attribution.description: Required CC BY 4.0 attribution to Open Charge Map contributors.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: OCM returned an empty result for the given numeric ID (HTTP 200 with []) — no such station. `upstream_unavailable`: OCM returned a non-2xx response or timed out. `auth_failed`: OCM returned HTTP 401 or 403 — the API key is missing or invalid. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

reliabilityNote.description: A caveat when the registry status, verification age, coordinates, or comments suggest the listing may not reflect reality. Omitted when there is nothing to flag.

comments.description: Community check-ins, present only when includeComments=true. Empty array means none on record.

checkinStatus.description: The visit outcome the driver recorded (e.g. "Charged Successfully", "Failed to Charge (Equipment Not Operational)"). Carries the result on check-ins that have no comment text. Absent when the visitor recorded no outcome.

checkinStatusId.description: Numeric ID of the check-in outcome, stable across renames of its title.

checkinStatusIsPositive.description: Whether the registry classes this outcome as a good visit. Absent when the outcome carries no verdict either way (e.g. "Did Not Visit Location") or when none was recorded.

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the comment was posted.

rating.description: User rating 1–5. null when not given.

relatedUrl.description: Link the commenter attached. Absent when none was given.

connections.description: Connectors at the station. Empty when OCM has no connection data on record.

connectionTypeId.description: Connector type ID — resolve via openchargemap_lookup_reference.

powerKW.description: Rated power in kW for this connection. null/absent when unknown.

quantity.description: Number of connectors of this type. null when unknown.

dateLastStatusUpdate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last status update.

dateLastVerified.description: ISO 8601 date the listing was last verified. Stale (>12 months) is a reliability caveat. null when never verified.

distance.description: Distance from the search point. Absent for bounding-box searches.

generalComments.description: Operator/free-text notes about the station. Absent when none on record.

isAccessKeyRequired.description: Whether a physical access key is required. Absent when usage type is unknown.

isMembershipRequired.description: Whether a membership or RFID card is required. Absent when usage type is unknown.

isOperational.description: Whether the registry marks the status operational. Absent when the operational state is unknown. A true value can still mask a broken charger — corroborate with comments and dateLastVerified.

isPayAtLocation.description: Whether payment is required at the location. Absent when usage type is unknown.

isRecentlyVerified.description: Whether the listing was verified recently.

media.description: User-submitted photos of the station. Absent when none.

numberOfPoints.description: Reported number of charge points (stalls). Often absent — absence means unknown, not zero.

operator.description: Operating network name (e.g. "ChargePoint", "Tesla"). Absent when OCM has no operator on record.

operatorId.description: OCM operator ID — resolve names via openchargemap_lookup_reference.

status.description: Registry operational status (e.g. "Operational", "Temporarily Unavailable"). Operator-reported; may be stale.

statusTypeId.description: Registry status ID — the value the openchargemap_find_stations statustypeid filter takes. Absent when OCM has no status on record.

usageCost.description: Free-text cost description (e.g. "£0.30/kWh"). Often absent — absence means unknown, not free.

usageType.description: Access/usage type title (e.g. "Public", "Public - Pay At Location"). Absent when OCM has no usage type.

uuid.description: OCM station UUID — stable cross-system identifier (cannot be used as a lookup input).

title: openchargemap-mcp-server: get station
